picks.title: OpenAI delaying IPO amid AI safety concerns, Sam Altman says
picks.why_it_matters: OpenAI staying private longer extends the runway for AI startups to compete before facing a publicly-capitalized giant, while signaling that safety concerns may slow the broader sector's commercialization pace.

picks.title: Anthropic, OpenAI CEOs call for slowdown in AI development
picks.why_it_matters: Major AI labs advocating for development slowdowns could trigger regulatory action that reshapes competitive dynamics, potentially creating openings for startups focused on safety tooling, alignment, or compliant AI infrastructure.

picks.title: Getting 50 GB/S Back from the Apple Neural Engine
picks.why_it_matters: Unlocking underutilized Apple silicon performance creates opportunities for startups building on-device AI applications that bypass cloud costs and latency constraints.
